system.description:
This Homebrew Content has been Tested per the Untested guidelines. Whether or not it can be used is, as always, the prerogative of the Gamemaster.

Homebrew Reference Book: New Republic Campaign Guide

See also: Feats, Regional Feats

You were born and raised in The Inner Rim.

Effect: You were raised in The Inner Rim, for many centuries the edge of the known galaxy. You are considered Trained in Use Computer. You may reroll any Use Computer checks made to Astrogate, keeping the better of the two results.

Special: You may only select a single Regional Feat.
